title: Gimmicky and overpriced, the panini attachment costs the same as buying a panini press!
text:
Gimmicky and overpriced, the panini attachment costs the same as buying a panini press!. I got this because I toast bread, do waffles, poptarts- all sorts of stuff in the toaster on a regular basis so I figured I'd treat myself... SO it arrived and it's absolutely beautiful, the touchscreen is awesome and it's easy to use! That's the GOOD.

The bad is on waffles no matter what setting I use- it cooks them and leaves the edges kind of soft for some reason and the middle part is burnt. I don't know why but there's a round burnt ring on the middle that's about the size of a silver dollar- it burns it black too. The next bad thing on the waffle setting was to get the edges done I had to sometimes run the frozen waffle cycle 2 or 3 times. YES this thing cooks fast but when you factor in having to run it in there 2-3 times, not much time is really saved there.

I got about every bread this thing has an option for and the results for each weren't much better sadly. It was just MEH on each one. Didn't take my breath away at all and I truly expected a $400 toaster to be amazing! The truth is my $40 toaster does the same thing but better. A cheap toaster does what this does so you're paying for a fun fancy touch screen. Just get a cheap toaster and burn a few pieces if need be to find your perfect setting and write it down on a post-it to remember.

As far as the attachments- WAY overpriced. The panini attachment costs what a panini press would actually cost! $80 for a metal tray is insane! It probably cost them $2-$5 to manufacture that so it's highway robbery! But it's literally a metal-hinged tray your sandwich goes in. Cuisinart makes the GR-11 model and it's currently on Amazon for $59.99 and does a fantastic job! George Foreman has a panini press for $28 even! The point is why pay MORE for a little metal tray? You already paid the high price of $400 so why extort more money out of people? Accessories shouldn't be more expensive than an actual appliance. The whole idea is to be cheaper. That press shouldn't cost more than about $20. The warming tray costs $30 which is INSANE because you can buy a huge baking sheet for that! This is a tiny metal rack that sits on top of the toaster. Should cost like $10-15. My advice there is to just find a little metal rack and sit it on top of the toaster instead- use one of the wire ones as a baking sheet would trap heat in and hurt your appliance.

Bottom line? Overpriced gimmick with overpriced attachments. I know it says I get items for "free" so you'd wonder why I'm so pressed about the price but I will end up paying nearly $100 in taxes on this toaster and considering I have a nice 4 slot generic toaster that cooks more at once and does a better job that I paid $40 for, yeah I'm a little bitter about that! I'd honestly return this if that was an option for us.
